title: Cardiac Arrest Survival Act of 2025
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.
summary:
Cardiac Arrest Survival Act of 2025

This bill expands immunity from civil liability related to emergency use of automated external defibrillator devices (AEDs).

In particular, the bill specifies that immunity applies regardless of whether the person who used the AED complied with signage, received training, or was assisted or supervised by another person, such as a licensed physician. It also specifies that immunity applies to an entity that owns, leases, or manages a premises on which an AED is used but does not own or use the AED. Additionally, the bill limits the liability of the person who owns or acquires an AED for harm resulting from its use unless that person fails to appropriately maintain the AED.
